paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: Illustrating the empirical generalization errors and sharpness measures with respect to QLoRA weights. (<ref>) Smaller adapters with a rank of 16 achieve the lowest generalization errors. Additionally, the Hessian trace values correlate with generalization errors, suggesting that smaller adapters tend to converge to flatter minima. (<ref>) An ensemble of k adapters leads to lower generalization errors and Hessian traces. Here, we fix the sum of the dimensions of k adapters to be equal to 256. (<ref>) QLoRA, which is trained on a quantized base model, yields lower generalization errors and Hessian trace values compared to LoRA.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Ето анализ на графиката, който сте предоставили:

Графиката показва промени в стойностите на проследяванията по отношение на ранга. Оста X е озаглавена "Rank" и е линейна скала, която варира от 4 до 256, с етикети, поставени на 4, 16, 64 и 256. Оста Y е озаглавена "Traces × 10−5 (RTE)" и е линейна скала, варираща от 0 до 6, с етикети на 0, 3 и 6. На графиката се показва една линия с червен цвят, предварително зададена с кръгли маркери. Линията започва на 4 на оста X с стойност приблизително 0.25 на оста Y, минава през точка с координати (16, 0.12), достига минимална стойност приблизително 0.08 на (64, 0.08) и завършва на 256 с приблизително 3.5.
model_annotations.English:
Here's a description of the plot, following your instructions:

The plot illustrates a relationship between rank and a measured value, represented as "Traces × 10⁻⁵ (RTE)". The x-axis is labeled "Rank" and utilizes a linear scale, ranging from 4 to 256 with equally spaced tick labels at 4, 16, 64, and 256. The y-axis is labeled with numeric values and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at 0.0, 3.0, and 6.0. A single black solid line is displayed, with circular markers at each data point. The line begins at a value of approximately 0.22 at rank 4, decreases to approximately 0.15 at rank 16, increases to approximately 0.22 at rank 64, and concludes at approximately 3.57 at rank 256. Error bars are displayed at each x-axis tick, indicating variability in the y-axis values.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt Traces, die mit 10⁻⁵ multipliziert sind (RTE) in Bezug auf Rang darstellt. Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 4 bis 256 mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Abständen von 4, 16, 64 und 256. Die y-Achse ist ebenfalls linear skaliert und reicht von 0 bis 6 mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Abständen von 0, 3 und 6. Eine einzige schwarze, durchgezogene Linie wird geplottet, die mit dem Wert 0,22 bei einem Rang von 4 beginnt und anfangs abfällt bis zu einem Minimum von 0,18 bei einem Rang von 16, bevor sie ansteigt und einen Wert von 0,37 erreicht, wenn der Rang 256 beträgt. Am Ende des Diagramms werden Fehlerbalken um jeden Datenpunkt gezeigt.
